description: Conformance fixtures for Open Memory Format readers. A reader claims conformance by accepting every fixture with "valid": true and rejecting every fixture with "valid": false, for the reason given. See conformance/README.md.

cases.reason: A minimal 1.0 document with no $format and no mediaFiles. Readers MUST accept any 1.x document and treat a missing mediaFiles as an empty list.
A complete 1.1 document ($format, all sections, a mediaFiles entry). Identical to examples/nora-hart.omf.json.
A hypothetical future minor version (1.9) with unknown manifest, record, and top-level fields. Readers MUST accept it and ignore what they don't know; importers SHOULD preserve the unknown fields.
formatVersion 2.0: a different major version is a breaking change. Readers MUST reject it loudly, never misread it.
manifest.formatVersion is absent. Readers MUST reject a document whose version they cannot establish.
The archive section is missing. Readers MUST reject a document with no archive (or an archive without a string id).
The letters section is missing. Every section except mediaFiles is required; readers MUST reject the document.
The document is a JSON array, not an object. Readers MUST reject anything that is not a JSON object.
